name: token-saver
description: Model-tier routing ladder (Haiku -> verify -> escalate, with an MCP advisory tool + a PreToolUse gate that forces consulting it before subagent delegation) + waste-detection coaching hooks for Claude Code, a Skill+MCP fallback for Claude Desktop's Code tab (with DIY config tools), a deterministic PreToolUse guard against duplicate/oversized rereads, a PreToolUse gate forcing a 4-slot echo on ambiguous turns, PostToolUse trimmers for oversized Grep/Bash output, and a real-time pace line for 5h/weekly budgeting. Measured savings only (own harness cost model), no vendor claims. Early stage: v0.x, calibrated on N=6-7 sessions.
